title: Pilot block (the fenced discover-pilot JSON ending a pilot record, assessments/<project-id>/<date>-<runner>-pilot.md)

commit.description: The commit every session started from, so the frontier was frozen.

mode.description: light: one fresh session and one that inherits its result, run while setting a project up. full: the hub's trial, three fresh sessions and a wave inheriting the best (spec §3.6).

runner.description: Who ran the pilot and checked its results.

self_piloted.description: Run by the project's maintainers or for them during setup, not by the hub.

fresh.description: Started with no context but the donation prompt. A session the runner did itself is not fresh, and counts for less.

inherits.description: The session whose result this one started from.

first_result_minutes.description: Minutes to its first result that passed the project's check; null if none did.

outcome.description: progress: a result that passed the runner's own check. no-progress: nothing beat the frontier. invalid: a claimed result failed the check, a constraint or a guard. setup-failed: couldn't get the first step to run.

beats_strongest.description: Whether its result also beats the strongest known baseline, not only the project's current one; null if not compared.

measures_ok.description: Whether its result meets every constraint and worsens no guard or target (spec §5, Measures); null if the project declares none.

criteria.description: Each suitability criterion (spec §3.6): a rating and the evidence for it.

bottleneck.description: What the pilot showed limits progress (spec §4, bottleneck).

verdict.description: What the hub can promise donors (spec §3.6). Separate from the stage, which measures readiness.

next.description: The one experiment or change that would most improve the verdict.
